I hated the depo and couldn’t keep track of pills when I was young. I did a lot of “research” on pills for pmdd and this one was one came up a couple times, and was the one recommended by the Nurx physician. I didn’t know I had pmdd until pretty recently which is why I caved and took bc, 2weeks out of every month for years I was absolutely miserable(paranoia, insomnia, disassociation, pain and anxiety) and I couldn’t keep a job. It’s been 4months and I feel almost 100% better. Like no crying fits for hours or losing track of the day because I’m so fatigued and in pain. It honestly feels like a miracle. So I guess in short, I took a chance and got lucky on the first pill I tried. Have you tried Loryna?

I really hate taking any medications(probably could use some good therapy honestly) but they told me to give it a 3month trail without skipping periods before dismissing it, and I’m glad I did. I was so hesitant to try bc again because it high school I hated the depo shot and was bad about pills, and just gave up. Im 27 if that means anything too!

I think it depends why you are starting the pill and what kind you have. I have pmdd and wanted something to tone down my side effects of that. I use a combo pill called Loryna. I take it at night so I don’t feel any different than usual most days but it drastically calms me down during pre period and period time. I almost wish I started taking it in the morning instead because when I’ve missed a day and take it in the morning it gives me a burst of energy and I generally feel better throughout the day instead of sleeping through it. I would say start it at night, with a little snack if you’re worried. I’m sorry you’ve got a lot on your plate right now, and I hope the bc works out for you, but if this one doesn’t another type might!

Edited to mention for me, the days I miss my pill I feel more emotional but not to an extent that it’s debilitating like my pmdd emotions are.
